title: Eritrea NDC 3.0
organization: Government of the State of Eritrea; submitted to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: Historical climate observations through 2018, recent drought context and climate projections to 2100
methodology: NDC summarizes national studies, consultations, field visits and IPCC AR5-based projections.
limitations: Observed data and group rankings are cited; projections are model-dependent (RCP2.6/RCP8.5).

title: Inclusive and Sustainable Development
organization: United Nations Development Programme, Eritrea Country Office
temporal_coverage: Undated page; land and agriculture figures attributed on-page to Ministry of Agriculture 2022
methodology: UNDP country-page description of its development portfolio and cited national agricultural context; no separate method is stated.
limitations: Undated, mutable webpage; the cited agricultural figures are attributed to the Ministry of Agriculture 2022.

title: Climate Change Adaptation Programme in Water and Agriculture in Anseba Region, Eritrea: Request for Project/Programme Funding
organization: Adaptation Fund; implementing entity UNDP; executing entity Ministry of Agriculture, Anseba Region
temporal_coverage: Project proposal with undated receipt field; includes historical baselines and long-range climate projections
methodology: Project-funding proposal combining local water and agriculture context, national adaptation projections and proposed interventions for Anseba.
limitations: Proposal is not an evaluation; its explicit water-land conflict statement is a prospective risk hypothesis and the cited passage gives no empirical conflict estimate.

title: Ex Post Evaluation #6: Climate Change Adaptation Programme in Water and Agriculture in Anseba Region, Eritrea
organization: Adaptation Fund Technical Evaluation Reference Group; evaluation conducted by Universalia Management Group
temporal_coverage: AF-supported project outcomes seven years after its 2018 closure; fieldwork in August 2025.
methodology: Independent AF-TERG ex-post evaluation using document review, interviews, focus groups, transect walks, observation and site visits.
limitations: Eight of 16 project sites were visited; findings are not a region-wide census.

title: Returning Thirsty: Water Supply, Livelihoods and Returnees in the Gash-Barka Region, Eritrea
organization: Overseas Development Institute, South Bank University and Eritrean research collaborators
temporal_coverage: Post-border-war return and resettlement period; field research around 2001 and report published in 2002.
methodology: Field research in nine Gash-Barka communities using rapid appraisal, interviews and a structured 156-household survey.
limitations: Historical post-conflict study; reports localized resource tensions, not climate-caused or widespread armed violence.

title: Climate Change Adaptation Programme in Water and Agriculture in Anseba Region, Eritrea: Eritrea Case Study
organization: United Nations Development Programme Adaptation Learning Mechanism
temporal_coverage: Historical climate and livelihood conditions reported for a 2012 project case study, including 2002–2004 rainfall impacts.
methodology: UNDP case study presents local climate, livelihood and water context for an adaptation programme and its design.
limitations: Project-preparation context, not a current reassessment or outcome evaluation; projections and conditions are dated.

title: Climate Risks and Adaptation Guidelines for Power Transmission and Solar Generation Systems in the Sahel Region: Country Chapter – Eritrea
temporal_coverage: Reference climatology 1961–1990, historical climate 1990–2020 and projections for 2030–2060.
methodology: Country chapter summarizes modelled hazards and risks to solar technologies, drawing on GCA's 2022 Sahel hazard assessment.
limitations: High-level, energy-asset assessment; the report calls for site-specific studies and notes climate-model uncertainty.
